A kiosk on the seafront

gSpot Cafe, on Facebook Gspot Beach, is a wooden kiosk on 28 Oktovriou in Limassol, across from the garden on the beach. Guests write about chairs under the trees, music in the background and freshly prepared drinks.

What guests say

Three of 130 Google reviews, 110 of them with five stars.
